independent_review.text:
# Independent review: radio public observer test successor

The bounded test-only change is supported, subject to the integrator checking the current test source before applying it. Candidate `397e588e4121f7b2fc896b307b8a4f5227d2792c`, base `107ccae1864dc4cbc56c4af1b8e70983a1fe947f`, patch SHA256 `16f1500bf5dc7d08da30cedfa6e8c1dc42ab8e7932eb3aac700af74b43689585`. The only modified path is `legacy-radio/radio.spec.ts`; both distinct existing case names remain unchanged.

The helper replaces direct spies on the current peer's `_controlValueAccessorChangeFn`, `_emitChangeEvent`, and `_touch` with public `registerOnChange`, `registerOnTouched` and `change` observers plus public group `value`/`selected` snapshots. The legacy buttons' `radioGroup === null` assertions remain. The observations test the intended externally visible no-association/no-change/no-touch behavior; they do not prove that no peer internal method was ever invoked. Both the nearer foreign group case and nearer foreign group with an outer legacy group are retained.

Reviewed candidate report SHA256 `d1289492b7495ecbffb3b08ad5b425b60740dd3fa0868a357edd149bb0108e88`, 100/100 passed, and the older baseline report `97c149503ce60f0fbe898f970ee208e1f7cbb3a762c4ef16efe939a9e5a38264`, 94/100: both target cases fail through the public change observer and four other older-product failures concern the separate focus and required-scheduling controls. Both reports' artifact hash fields are null. I independently compared all 512 extracted regular members for each report's package root with its tar: zero mismatches; candidate tar SHA256 `b42bd87238076488f0fd7bf5ff7b7e61d4a781c8988e02647e0bdd9109e7806c`, baseline `bdc8cfd77bd36638c7ae8ad74437b94d37aeddca6abd32560300a31d8a849b84`. The b42 product sources match the base product; intervening tracked project changes are test files only. The linked canonical `node_modules` were neither protected against concurrent writes nor fully closure-frozen during the retained run.

No independent browser replay or new product pack was performed. This does not grant strict no-Zone, 21.x, x64, full historical inventory, security or release coverage.
